product_one_liner.value: Auterion Suite automates robotics fleet operations for operators, team leads, program managers and subject-matter experts.

pricing_page.notes: The page links to the full Auterion Suite pricing plans.

employee_band.notes: LinkedIn lists the company size as 201–500 employees.

eng_blog.notes: Both are technical posts authored by Auterion engineers or technical leads and discuss product implementation.

public_docs.notes: The public documentation index lists multiple product, hardware-integration and application-development articles.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live board includes a Computer Vision Engineer posting.

model_provider.notes: Auterion describes VISIONAIRY as deployable on its AI Node/Skynode as an integration; it does not say this is the default model.

compliance_certs.notes: The privacy policy names GDPR and says Auterion is committed to complying with applicable data-protection laws; this is a legal-compliance statement, not an audited certification.

raised_18mo.notes: The Series B was announced in September 2025, within the 18-month window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The open jobs board lists roles but none is titled SDR, BDR, sales/business development representative, or account executive.

launched_6mo.notes: Auterion introduced the Nemyx Vertical Launch System on October 5, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: The profile lists a Vice President role at Auterion starting in December 2025, within the 12-month window.

crm_stack_signal.notes: A RevOps job post names HubSpot in the GTM stack; the sub-processor statement also lists HubSpot for customer fulfillment and marketing.
